cross_validation: GroupKFold by course-topic task; all profile outputs for a task remain in the same fold.
limitations: The feature set is finite and cannot rule out unmeasured surface cues.
Several features, such as formulas or code depth, may be intended pedagogical adaptations rather than nuisance cues.
The analysis tests predictability of profile labels, not whether human raters used the same features.
model: standardized multinomial logistic regression with class balancing
permutation_test: 2000 within-task label permutations; exploratory sensitivity only

results.interpretation: Sensitivity analysis only: prediction above chance suggests that the measured surface features contain profile-correlated information, but does not establish whether those cues are pedagogically intended or construct-irrelevant.
